scope: Independent QA re-verification of the S6b render-context lifecycle slice: 100 create/destroy cycles (memory growth), stale BVH until explicit refit, no implicit refresh during render, disabled-output rejection, drop releasing mesh/texture/output resources back to baseline, world-count mismatch rejection, 5/5 GPU + 531-test gate, and the one-time 32 MiB driver code-cache observation. Fast-loop scope; no full G01; no product/fixture/original-evidence changes.

independent_method.lifecycle: QA harness target/qa-s6b-harness (product crate path dependency, no delivered test/support import) warmed up once, took a device_memory() baseline, ran 100 create->render->destroy cycles sampling free bytes every 10 cycles and comparing release_stats() counters
independent_method.stale_refit: single-box scene: initial hit, pose update without refit (A/B both miss), explicit refit (B hit, A miss), refit counters and pose-left-untouched checks around render calls
independent_method.outputs: rgb-only context: byte_len/read of depth and seg must be DisabledOutput, rgb bytes/values/all-zero checks against the S6a layout
independent_method.drop: warmup-then-measure with mesh + 3 textures: occupied bytes, mesh set_points stale->refit fresh semantics, texture sample, destroy retained bytes, recreate after destroy
independent_method.evidence: 5 artifacts re-hashed from git blobs (sha256/bytes/lines); 531-test suite; GPU window records

tests.delivered_gpu_test: 5 passed / 0 failed (tests body 7.56 s); numbers identical to the delivered evidence
tests.delivered_host_test: 2 passed / 0 failed (part of the 531 default-feature suite)

gpu_window.actual_gpu_time: about 1 minute (harness 6.2 s + delivered GPU test 7.6 s)

findings_non_blocking.title: delivered S6b receipt/README line counts do not match the committed blobs
findings_non_blocking.detail: owner.rs 364 vs 403, lifecycle.rs 322 vs 358, context.rs 397 vs 426, render/mod.rs 359 vs 368, tests/render_context_lifecycle.rs 477 vs 497. sha256 and byte counts match the committed blobs exactly, so this is a stale line-count field, not a content difference; the <=500-line rule still holds (max 497). Recommend a normify fix on the S6b README/receipt line fields (same treatment as the S1 field-diff line-count fix).

limitations: pixel render kernel (RGB/depth/seg shading, AA resolve, shadows/skybox/spot lights, texture/normal/specular/emission evaluation) is S7b and depends on the S7a launch ABI; render_rays is only a BVH-consuming query proxy, no image acceptance claimed
precomputed ray buffers remain with the S5 RayBuilder on demand; wiring them into the render context is S7b/S8
GPU cases use worlds=1 (multi-world BVH grouping was verified in S2a/S2b); no new multi-world fixture
upstream context retain/push/pop only needed by the S4 texture path; S6b adds no context operations

the one-time 32 MiB driver code cache was reproduced by the delivered GPU case (warmup retention 33,554,432 B) but not by the QA harness process this round (warmup retention 0 B); the 100-cycle growth 0 B and drop retained 0 B conclusions are identical
no full G01 in this round (fast-loop scope)
not_claimed: full renderer or product rendering acceptance
